content: WS auth: browsers cannot set custom headers on WebSocket handshake. Options: (1) query param token - simplest, WSS mitigates interception, risk of token in server/proxy logs; (2) Sec-WebSocket-Protocol subprotocol - keeps token out of URL, less common; (3) first-message auth - server accepts socket, waits for auth message, queues/blocks other messages until then (pattern used by cloudflare workers-chat-demo with blockedMessages queue). All viable; first-message used by official CF demo.
